reply.subject: Re: VPN help from off campus
reply.body: To connect from your laptop, install the GlobalProtect client from software.codis.edu/vpn, then sign in with your campus username and password and approve the Duo prompt. The gateway is vpn.codis.edu. When the client shows Connected, you can reach the library databases from off campus. If installation or sign-in gives you trouble, try the steps once more from a fresh browser session and confirm you're using your campus username rather than an email alias. Your next step: visit software.codis.edu/vpn now and install GlobalProtect before your research session.
